descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自己做的纸菜单，饼边两道小线记着那声脆响。
descriptions.en: Two little lines beside the edge of my homemade menu recall its crisp crack.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我做的纸菜单记着放稳的小勺，不把汤底固定为一种奶。
descriptions.en: My menu records a securely rested spoon without fixing the broth to one kind of milk.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使自剪的弧形纸签，记着一把普通雨伞投下的阴影。
descriptions.en: My own curved paper tab recalls the shade cast by an ordinary umbrella.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在折卡转角留出空处，记着邮包终于跟上转身的时刻。
descriptions.en: A gap in my folded card recalls the moment my mailbag finally followed my turn.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 两块自剪纸影子从中间分开，记着桥另一端的道别，不复制园方角色。
descriptions.en: Two original cut-paper shadows part at the middle for our goodbye beyond the bridge; no park character is copied.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使在纸条上压出一高一低的短折，记着那双努力安静的鞋。
descriptions.en: A high and a low fold in my paper strip recall shoes trying hard to be quiet.
